ch:reveil.title: &6I&r · The Awakening
ch:reveil.subtitle: An empty world. Not a grave, not a skeleton.
bienvenue.title: Welcome to the Airain Empire
bienvenue.subtitle: Click here to begin
bienvenue.desc: Long ago, the &6Airain Empire&r mastered a mechanical technology like no other.
Its ruins are still here, guarded by its old creations. Every guardian you defeat will give you back a piece of their knowledge.
&ePlaying together:&r join the same team (/ftbteams) to share quest book progress.
&eSchematics&r unlock the key machines. They are never consumed: keep them safe.
outils.title: Proper Tools
outils.desc: The world is dangerous. Start by gearing up properly.
journal1.title: The Engineer's Journal
journal1.desc: In a collapsed ruin, under mossy stones, you find a copper-bound notebook.
Most pages are unreadable. Not the last ones.
&oDay 412. The orders have come: everyone to the Core.&r
&oI am leaving this journal for those who come after.&r
&8Strange: no graves anywhere nearby. No bones.&r
alliage.title: Andesite Alloy
alliage.desc: The basis of all Airain mechanics: &6andesite alloy&r.
Andesite + iron (or zinc) nugget in a crafting table.
roue.title: The First Wheel
roue.desc: Place a water wheel in a stream: your first source of rotational force.
Wear the Engineer's Goggles to read speed and stress.
engrenages.title: Cogwheels
engrenages.desc: Small and large cogwheels: combine them to change rotation speed.
The faster it spins, the more stress it uses.
ch:andesite.title: &6II&r · The Andesite Age
ch:andesite.subtitle: The first machines. And ruins that are strangely clean.
boitier_andesite.title: Andesite Casing
boitier_andesite.desc: Apply andesite alloy to a stripped log to get a casing.
presse.title: The Mechanical Press
presse.desc: The press flattens ingots into sheets. Essential for what comes next.
mixeur.title: Mixer and Basin
mixeur.desc: A mixer above a basin combines ingredients. Later, with heat, it will work wonders.
broyeur.title: Grinding Stone
broyeur.desc: The millstone grinds ores and gravel and doubles your ore yield.
ventilateur.title: The Encased Fan
ventilateur.desc: A fan blowing through water washes items. Through fire, it smokes or smelts them.
ruines_propres.title: Well-Kept Ruins
ruines_propres.desc: The more you explore, the more one detail bothers you: some ruins are &oclean&r.
The mechanisms are oiled. The corridors, swept.
Maybe the guardians are not malfunctioning. They are doing maintenance.
&oThe copper sentinels will watch over the trial chambers.&r
salles_epreuve.title: The Trial Chambers
salles_epreuve.desc: Underground, halls of copper and tuff: the Empire's &6trial chambers&r.
gardien_vent.title: The Wind Guardian
gardien_vent.subtitle: Unlocks the Copper Schematic
gardien_vent.desc: The wind guardians protect the trial chambers. Defeat three of them.
&eReward:&r the &6Copper Schematic&r, which unlocks the mechanical pump, the spout and the item drain.
&8As it falls, the last guardian drops a shard of warm metal. A memory.&r
ch:cuivre.title: &6III&r · The Copper Age
ch:cuivre.subtitle: Fluids, the depths, and the inscriptions.
boitier_cuivre.title: Copper Casing
boitier_cuivre.desc: Copper applied to a stripped log makes the casing for fluid machines.
tuyaux.title: Plumbing
tuyaux.desc: Pipes carry water, lava and every fluid of the Empire.
pompe.title: The Mechanical Pump
pompe.desc: The pump moves fluids in the direction of rotation.
reservoir.title: Fluid Tanks
reservoir.desc: Fluid tanks combine into large volumes.
bec_verseur.title: Spout and Item Drain
bec_verseur.desc: The spout fills items, the item drain empties them. Both require the &6Copper Schematic&r.
vapeur.title: The Steam Engine
vapeur.desc: &7Optional.&r A boiler made of fluid tanks, water and fire: a lot of power.
inscriptions.title: The Inscriptions
inscriptions.desc: On the walls of a drowned ruin, inscriptions repeated hundreds of times:
Still no graves. Where did the inhabitants go?
&oThe tide guardians will keep the secret of the alloy.&r
&oNo one must find it before the time comes.&r
monument.title: The Sunken Ruins
monument.desc: At the bottom of the ocean, a prismarine temple. The Empire hid the secret of brass here.
&eBring water breathing potions, and use the pump to drain rooms.&r
gardien_marees.title: The Tide Guardian
gardien_marees.subtitle: Unlocks the Brass Schematic
gardien_marees.desc: An elder guardian watches over the temple.
&eReward:&r the &6Brass Schematic&r, which unlocks the blaze burner. No heat, no brass.
ch:laiton.title: &6IV&r · The Brass Age
ch:laiton.subtitle: The heart of the Empire's technology. And a hall full of empty capsules.
bruleur.title: The Blaze Burner
bruleur.desc: Craft an empty blaze burner (with the &6Brass Schematic&r), then trap a blaze inside.
Placed under a basin, it heats the mixer.
laiton.title: The Imperial Alloy
laiton.desc: Copper + zinc in a heated basin: &6brass&r, the sacred metal of the Empire.
boitier_laiton.title: Brass Casing
precision.title: Precision Mechanism
precision.desc: Sequenced assembly: a chain of deployers and presses that builds piece by piece.
&eTip:&r open the recipe in EMI and hold W over a machine to watch its Ponder tutorial.
bras.title: The Mechanical Arm
bras.desc: The arm moves items between machines. The deployer acts like a player.
rails.title: Laying Track
rails.desc: The ruins are far apart. Time to connect the world.
train.title: The First Train
train.desc: Controls, bogeys, assembly at a station: build a train and have it complete a full route.
Tick the checkbox when your train runs on its own.
capsules.title: The Capsule Hall
capsules.desc: Deep inside a ruin, a vast hall.
Thousands of brass capsules, lined up. &lAll empty.&r
Cables run out of them, all in the same direction: down.
&oThe transfer has begun. We enter the metal one by one.&r
&oI will be the last. I must finish this journal.&r
canons.title: Imperial Artillery
canons.desc: A Nether fortress guards the next secret. It will not fall to a sword.
Build a complete cannon: mount, barrels, breech, powder charges and shot.
&eTip:&r barrels are cast in molds, then bored out with the cannon drill.
nether.title: Into the Nether
forge_ames.title: The Soul Forge
forge_ames.subtitle: Unlocks the Sky Schematic
forge_ames.desc: Deep in a soul forge sleeps a &cNetherite Monstrosity&r. It wakes when you approach.
Bombard it, then finish the job.
&eReward:&r the &6Sky Schematic&r, which unlocks the physics assembler and the propeller bearing: the key to flying ships.
ch:ciel.title: &6V&r · The Sky Age
ch:ciel.subtitle: The Empire had flying cities.
envol.title: First Flight
envol.desc: With Create Aeronautics, build your first flying machine and take off.
The &6physics assembler&r (crafted with the Sky Schematic) turns your build into a vehicle.
Tick the checkbox once you have flown above the clouds.
navire_arme.title: The Warship
navire_arme.desc: Mount at least one cannon on your flying machine.
The sky is not empty: things may get rough from here.
end.title: Beyond the Portal
dragon.title: The Gatekeeper
dragon.desc: The dragon guards the way to the outer islands.
cite_volante.title: The Floating Cities
cite_volante.desc: Towers hanging over the void. The architecture is strangely reminiscent of the Empire's.
bientot.title: Soon
bientot.desc: Wherever you go, machines switch on by themselves. Gears turn with no power.
The last journal entry is a single line, in a shaky hand:
&oIt answered. It knows someone is coming.&r
citadelle.title: The Ruined Citadel
citadelle.subtitle: The last fragment
citadelle.desc: On the third floor of a ruined citadel in the End stands the &5Altar of Void&r. Approach it and the guardian awakens.
&8It does not die screaming. It whispers: "Soon."&r
ch:coeur.title: &6VI&r · Airain's Core
ch:coeur.subtitle: Gather the memories. Rekindle the Core.
assembleurs.title: The Mechanical Crafter
assembleurs.desc: The Core is forged on a 5×5 grid of mechanical crafters: you need 21 of them.
Connect them with the wrench so they work together.
memoires.title: The Four Memories
memoires.desc: Gears, Tides, Forge, Void. Each of the four guardians gave you back a memory.
Placed side by side, the fragments answer each other: their inscriptions form a single sentence.
forger.title: Forge the Core
forger.desc: Brass casings, precision mechanisms, a heart of the sea and the four fragments.
Check the recipe in EMI for the layout.
reactiver.title: Reawaken the Core
reactiver.subtitle: &cThe twist&r
reactiver.desc: You hold the Core in both hands. It pulses. It grows warm.
And far beneath your feet, something answers.
The journal opens by itself to a page that had stayed blank until now. Letters carve themselves into it, as if burned from within:
These pages, these guardians, these schematics: we placed them on your path.
We needed living hands to rekindle the Core.
We never vanished. We were waiting in the metal.
Now we return. And this world becomes ours again."&r
&8The reward shows you the direction of its cradle, and gives you the spark that will wake its master.&r
ch:reconquete.title: &4VII&r · The Reconquest
ch:reconquete.subtitle: The Empire is back. It wants its world.
eveil.title: The Empire Awakens
eveil.desc: The ruins no longer sleep. Mechanisms turn, sentinels patrol.
You gave the Empire back its Core. Now you must stop it.
Everything you built, the factory, the trains, the warship, is about to matter.
rempart.title: Fortify the Base
rempart.desc: Before you strike, protect what you have built: three cannon mounts around your base.
berceau.title: Cradle of the Empire
berceau.desc: An &6ancient factory&r buried around Y -30. The Core showed you the way.
This is where it all began. This is where it must end.
sentinelle.title: The Sentinel
sentinelle.desc: A mechanical sentinel guards the factory. Bring it down to clear the way.
etincelle.title: The Spark
etincelle.desc: The Emperor still sleeps inside his machine. A Nether Star is enough to wake him.
The Core gave you one. If it is lost, you will have to defeat a Wither.
empereur.title: The Airain Emperor
empereur.subtitle: &4Final boss&r
empereur.desc: At the center of the factory, a huge machine, motionless. The Emperor, fused with what he built.
Right-click it with the Nether Star to wake him.
&cHe is extremely dangerous.&r Gear up as best you can and fight together.
epilogue.title: Epilogue
epilogue.desc: Silence returns. The Empire's machines stop one by one, for good this time.
Airain's Core still pulses in your inventory. More gently.
It answers to no one anymore. It is yours.
&6Thank you for playing The Airain Empire.&r
ch:arsenal.title: &3Side&r · Arsenal and Magic
ch:arsenal.subtitle: Airain technology so advanced it looks like spells.
a_table.title: The Inscription Table
a_table.desc: The Empire's &6scrolls&r are miniaturized circuits. The inscription table lets you engrave them into a spell book.
a_journal.title: First Spell Book
a_essence.title: Arcane Essence
a_forge.title: The Scroll Forge
a_tome.title: The Ironbound Tome
a_mithril.title: Mithril
a_codex.title: The Ancient Codex
a_codex.desc: The ultimate spell book. A true mage of the Empire.
ch:production.title: &3Side&r · Production Challenges
ch:production.subtitle: The Empire produced without rest. Do better.
p_alliage.title: A Thousand Alloys
p_plaques.title: Rolling Mill
p_laiton.title: Brass Foundry
p_precision.title: Precision Line
p_rails.title: The Great Network
ch:exploration.title: &3Side&r · Exploration
ch:exploration.subtitle: Mapping what the Empire left behind.
e_cite.title: The Ancient City
e_cite.desc: A city swallowed by darkness. &cTotal silence recommended.&r
e_bastion.title: The Bastion
e_fortin.title: The Stronghold
e_pyramide.title: The Desert Temple
e_manoir.title: The Woodland Mansion
file.title: The Airain Empire
